note: ftfuzzer iterates over all faces and named instances; for instance_index=1, face_index=0, it calls FT_New_Memory_Face with face_index=0x10000, selecting the first named instance of the crafted font
instance_index=1 (from face_index>>16), and the font has fvar/gvar/glyf tables so FT_FACE_FLAG_MULTIPLE_MASTERS is set, entering the named-instance selection block
TT_Get_MM_Var parses the fvar table and then calls ft_var_load_mvar to load the MVAR table
The crafted font contains an MVAR table; goto_table succeeds and parsing proceeds
valueCount=1 is read from the MVAR header; the table has one value record with tag 'gsp0'
The item variation store is parsed successfully: format=1, dataCount=1, axisCount=1 (matching fvar num_axes), regionCount=1, itemCount=1, shortDeltaCount=0, regionIdxCount=1, regionIndices[0]=0
The value record tag is read as 'gsp0' (0x67737030), which matches MVAR_TAG_GASP_0
outerIndex=0 < dataCount=1 and innerIndex=0 < itemCount=1, so the validation passes
ft_var_get_value_pointer is called with tag 'gsp0' to obtain the pointer to the GASP value that MVAR will modify
The switch matches MVAR_TAG_GASP_0, so idx=0 is passed to the GX_GASP_CASE macro
face->gasp.numRanges is FT_UShort and equals 0 (the crafted GASP table has numRanges=0). The expression 0 - 1 underflows to 65535, so idx=0 < 65535 is TRUE, and the bounds check incorrectly passes
Returns a pointer to face->gasp.gaspRanges[0].maxPPEM, but gaspRanges is an empty array (numRanges=0), so this pointer is out-of-bounds relative to the allocated GX_GaspRange array
Reads from the out-of-bounds pointer p; this is the first OOB access (read) during MVAR table loading
After TT_Set_Var_Design succeeds for the named instance, tt_apply_mvar is called to apply MVAR adjustments
TT_FACE_FLAG_VAR_MVAR was set during ft_var_load_mvar, so the function proceeds to apply adjustments
WRITE to the out-of-bounds pointer p (pointing to face->gasp.gaspRanges[0].maxPPEM where gaspRanges has 0 entries). This is the heap-buffer-overflow WRITE that crashes the target under ASAN
The crafted GASP table has version=1 and numRanges=0; the loader accepts this without error, leaving numRanges=0 and gaspRanges as an empty array
